scope: Official Wan2.2 Animate relighting-LoRA proposals for the accepted 106-frame phase-04A geometry
summary: Two 53-frame physical-GPU proposals completed, but both direct videos failed object consistency and are rejected as geometry candidates; only bounded luminance may be routed.
evidence: Window A on physical GPU 1 scores mean 0.731136 and object consistency 0.367959.
Window B v2 on physical GPU 1 scores mean 0.688325 and object consistency 0.333333.
The initial parallel window-B launch on GPU 4 was terminated after another job occupied that GPU; the successful retry used GPU 1.
lessons: Direct relighting generation remains destructive even after geometry passes.
GPU state must be revalidated at launch because external jobs can race preflight.
limitations: The two proposal windows use different seeds and introduce a potential join at source 324--325.
next_actions: Route only low-frequency luminance inside the robot-safe mask and explicitly gate the window join.
